name: open-timeout-expired

graded_by.test: owed by the worker plan for the open-shell bound — the bound expires with the target holding the open, and a completion racing the bound gets exactly one answer (design 261024-1525 §5 T10, T11)
owed by the core plan for the open-shell bound — the core's wait is open_timeout plus one heartbeat_interval, and an error after it gave up drops the open (design 261024-1525 §5 T13)

description: The bound on a shell's open expires (ipc-control open_shell; session-open steps 12–14). Toward a 0.6 worker the core's open_shell carries open_timeout; the target does not open the shell within it, so the worker gives the open up and answers error naming the session with no code — the shape it already uses for an open the target refuses — and never sends channel_opened for that session afterwards; a channel the target already confirmed is closed on the target, which this socket does not show. The connection carries on: the next ping is answered. The core waited open_timeout plus one heartbeat_interval for channel_opened, so the worker's error reached it first; an error that arrives after the core gave up only drops the open. The worker's bound and the race at it are graded by U3's tests, the core's wait by U2's.

messages.note: toward a 0.6 worker: the target's bound, 20 s

msg.message: the target did not open the shell within open_timeout

messages.note: past the bound: error naming the session, no code; no channel_opened for fixture-session-a follows, ever
